title: Session 10: HTML5 Tables, Audio, and Video

questions.questionText: A table is made up of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Rows and columns.

questions.questionText: The intersection of a row and a column is called a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Cell.

questions.questionText: Which element creates a table?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <table>.

questions.questionText: Which element divides a table into rows?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <tr>.

questions.questionText: Which element specifies a data cell (column entry) in a row?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <td>.

questions.questionText: By default, a table:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Has no border.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of <table> specifies a border?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) border.

questions.questionText: Which element specifies a column heading?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <th>.

questions.questionText: Text in a <th> element appears:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Bold.

questions.questionText: Which attribute extends a cell across multiple columns?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) colspan.

questions.questionText: Which attribute extends a cell across multiple rows?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) rowspan.

questions.questionText: colspan="2" means the cell spans:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Two columns.

questions.questionText: The rowspan attribute can be used within:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <td> and <th>.

questions.questionText: Spanning refers to:
options: Extending a cell across multiple rows or columns
questions.correctAnswer: Extending a cell across multiple rows or columns
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Extending a cell across multiple rows or columns.

questions.questionText: By default, data within a table cell is aligned:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) To the left.

questions.questionText: By default, table headings are aligned:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) To the center.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property sets horizontal alignment in table cells?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) text-align.

questions.questionText: Which attribute was used for vertical alignment but is deprecated in HTML5?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) valign.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property sets vertical alignment of table cell content?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) vertical-align.

questions.questionText: Cell padding is the space between:
options: The text and the cell border
questions.correctAnswer: The text and the cell border
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The text and the cell border.

questions.questionText: Which element specifies the title of an entire table?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) <caption>.

questions.questionText: How many captions can a table have?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) One.

questions.questionText: To set a table's width to the full browser window, set width to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 100%.

questions.questionText: A column width in pixels can be set by using the style attribute in the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) <td> tag.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property sets all of width, color, and style of a border at once?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) border.

questions.questionText: To format only the bottom border, use:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) border-bottom.

questions.questionText: For layout, tables are used to:
options: Organize content in rows and columns
questions.correctAnswer: Organize content in rows and columns
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Organize content in rows and columns.

questions.questionText: In current practice, CSS is preferred over tables for layout because it:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Is more flexible and reliable.

questions.questionText: Earlier, playing video in a browser required:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A plug-in or ActiveX control.

questions.questionText: HTML5 introduced which two media elements?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <audio> and <video>.

questions.questionText: HTML5 media elements remove the dependency on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Flash.

questions.questionText: Multimedia is a combination of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Video, graphics, sound, and text.

questions.questionText: A codec is:
options: A device or program that encodes and decodes digital data streams
questions.correctAnswer: A device or program that encodes and decodes digital data streams
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A device or program that encodes and decodes digital data streams.

questions.questionText: A container format stores:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Coded video and audio together.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a container format?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Ogg.

questions.questionText: The src attribute of <audio> specifies:
options: The URL of the audio file
questions.correctAnswer: The URL of the audio file
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The URL of the audio file.

questions.questionText: Commonly used audio formats include:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) wav, ogg, and mp3.

questions.questionText: Which tag specifies multiple media sources for <audio> or <video>?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <source>.

questions.questionText: When there are multiple <source> elements, the browser uses:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The first format it supports.

questions.questionText: The controls attribute of <audio>:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Displays audio playback controls.

questions.questionText: The autoplay attribute:
options: Starts playback as soon as possible
questions.correctAnswer: Starts playback as soon as possible
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Starts playback as soon as possible.

questions.questionText: The loop attribute:
options: Replays the audio once it stops
questions.correctAnswer: Replays the audio once it stops
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Replays the audio once it stops.

questions.questionText: The preload attribute is ignored if:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) autoplay exists.

questions.questionText: The <embed> tag is used to play audio in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Older browsers.

questions.questionText: The <embed> attribute autostart="false" means:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Audio will not play automatically.

questions.questionText: Which element embeds video content in HTML5?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <video>.

questions.questionText: Content placed between <video> and </video> is displayed:
options: If the browser does not support the video tag
questions.correctAnswer: If the browser does not support the video tag
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) If the browser does not support the video tag.

questions.questionText: Which attribute starts the video as soon as it is ready?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) autoplay.

questions.questionText: The muted attribute:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Mutes the video initially.

questions.questionText: The preload="none" value means the video:
options: Is not downloaded when the page loads
questions.correctAnswer: Is not downloaded when the page loads
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Is not downloaded when the page loads.

questions.questionText: The preload="metadata" value:
options: Loads only metadata when the page loads
questions.correctAnswer: Loads only metadata when the page loads
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Loads only metadata when the page loads.

questions.questionText: Which is a royalty-free, open-source video format?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Ogg Theora.

questions.questionText: H.264/MP4 is supported on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) iPhone and Android devices.

questions.questionText: Web Video Text Tracks (WebVTT) is a format used to:
options: Mark up external text tracks for video
questions.correctAnswer: Mark up external text tracks for video
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Mark up external text tracks for video.

questions.questionText: The <track> element is used to add:
options: Captions, subtitles, and chapters to audio/video
questions.correctAnswer: Captions, subtitles, and chapters to audio/video
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Captions, subtitles, and chapters to audio/video.
